commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the middle of the goal from distance, but Jose Sa hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
90+6' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
90+4' 2 - 1 Goal! Andre (Wolves) collected a pass and decided to try his luck from distance. The shot was deflected and it was enough to turn the ball past helpless Alisson. 2:1.

90+2' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Jose Sa. This effort really didn't trouble him.
90+2' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+1' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) will take the corner.

87' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for Wolves.

86' Joao Gomes (Wolves) probably spotted the goalkeeper off his line, but he misdirected his long-range shot as it went a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
85' Wolves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
85' A cross from Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

83' 1 - 1 An amazing individual effort from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the right side of the goal and makes it 1:1. Jose Sa was helpless.
81' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Liverpool comes to nothing.

80' Rio Ngumoha (Liverpool) collects a pin-point pass inside the box and fires towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper dives perfectly and tips the ball onto the post. That was a fantastic reflex save! The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
